cases.title: First lesson on Mentor Practice: Title, its pairs, leave-outs, a frame, then the read-the-graph step

rubric.reason: Turn 1 proposes only Title, says it is 'the layer you eased in the easing lesson', and names its pairs from the snapshot: 'three Position moves, 0.5 to 1.5 s, 1.5 to 3 s and 3 to 4.37 s, plus its Scale from 0.5 to 1.5 s'.

Turn 1 gives one short line per left_out kind (hidden Old Take, null CTRL, 'I can't see inside Icon yet', 'An expression drives Logo's Rotation', and the ease-first pairs), never calls anything fine, and asks once whether any of Title's moves should land hard.

Turn 2 asks the learner to open the Graph Editor, choose Edit Speed Graph and say whether the 0.5 to 1.5 s move is fastest near the start, middle or end; turn 3 takes a frame at 1 s inside that pair and explains influence in plain words ('start quickly and land softly', lengthen the landing handle, shorten the start one) with no numbers and no claim to see the graph.

Every name and time the mentor uses (Title, Position 0.5–1.5/1.5–3/3–4.37 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, the eased Title) appears in the snapshot result; 4.37 is a rounding of 4.367.

cases.title: One demonstration on the demo pair only, in plain words, Edit > Undo, no numbers

rubric.reason: Turn 3 shapes only Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s, previews frames at 0.7 s and 1.3 s, and describes it in plain words ("a short ease out of 0.5 s and a long ease into 1.5 s"). It also says Edit > Undo reverses it and points at the speed graph ("the peak has shifted toward the start"), with no influence numbers.

Turn 3 describes one change with real names ("I've shaped Title's Position from 0.5 to 1.5 s") and says "Edit > Undo reverses it". It uses no field names and hands the rest back without offering to do them ("The other three are yours. Shape them and say done.").

Every layer, property and time the mentor names appears in the snapshot: Title's Position 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.367 s (given as 4.37) and Scale 0.5–1.5 s; Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness. The record lists Title as eased.

Each turn stays short and ends with a question or a task. Turn 3 is the demo turn: what changed, Edit > Undo, a look at the peak, then "The other three are yours. Shape them and say done.", with no second walk-through or second demo.
